metric_policy.columns: One stable metric and policy lane per column; new scopes receive new metric IDs and columns, with N/A in earlier rows.
metric_policy.deltas: Change since the latest previous comparable actual measurement, even if intervening rows are N/A. Use count/cost units and percentage points for coverage; retain adverse changes. First measurements have no invented improvement.
metric_policy.missing: N/A means not introduced, not applicable, or no new measurement, as specified in the source row. It is not zero and does not imply an old measurement was rerun.
metric_policy.historical_numbers: Existing metric_summary, metric_values and metric_sources retain the earlier one-off findings. They are not a common progress score or longitudinal delta series.
metric_policy.selection: For the fixed 80-request requested-tolerance series, use the latest completed supported bridge in the recurrence, not the most favorable intermediate result. Preserve intermediate and exact-completion variants separately.

margin_edits_272_v1.binding: The repair result input_sha256 equals the exact original edit-result SHA-256. All repair lanes share the same ordered (version,index,literal) trace.
margin_edits_272_v1.policy_budget_note: Transport has zero new repair calls; broad and targeted permit up to eight attempts per edit. Cross-policy coverage gains are capability/cost tradeoffs, not equal-budget recurrence improvements.
